propositions: The code-review-verify spec outputs no decision polarity (only verifications list), causing _verdict_decision to fall through to advisory regardless of gold label.
Every verify case is scored advisory, guaranteeing a recall miss for V-real-defect (gold block) on both standard and frontier arms.
Treating non-empty verifications as block would fix the recall miss but simultaneously mis-score V-clean-rename (gold advisory) as block, creating a false accept.
code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus via a named POLARITY_FREE_SOLVERS set distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to preserve the exclusion reason and prevent silent re-admission.
The fix raises n_gold from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20) and improves recall on both arms without changing gating verdicts or false-accept outcomes.
